# Standards Quality Checklist

Use this checklist to ensure standards meet quality requirements before submission and approval.
page_texts.3:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#content-completeness]

### Content Completeness

- [ ] Standards metadata is complete and accurate
- [ ] Standard ID follows convention: `STD-{DOMAIN}-{TYPE}-{NNN}`
- [ ] Standard ID is unique within the repository
- [ ] Executive summary clearly states purpose and scope
- [ ] Compliance level is clearly defined (mandatory/recommended/guidance)
- [ ] Business rationale is well articulated
- [ ] All required sections are present and populated
- [ ] Standard requirements are specific and measurable
page_texts.4:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#requirements-quality]

### Requirements Quality

- [ ] Mandatory requirements are enforceable and verifiable
- [ ] Recommended practices provide clear guidance
- [ ] Prohibited practices are explicitly defined
- [ ] Exception process is clearly documented
- [ ] Requirements avoid ambiguous language
- [ ] Compliance criteria are objective and testable
page_texts.5:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#technical-accuracy]

### Technical Accuracy

- [ ] Technical specifications are detailed and implementable
- [ ] Technology standards include specific versions and configurations
- [ ] Architecture constraints are justified and necessary
- [ ] Configuration specifications are complete and accurate
- [ ] Implementation guidelines are actionable
- [ ] Testing requirements are comprehensive
page_texts.6:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#documentation-quality]

### Documentation Quality

- [ ] Writing is clear, concise, and professional
- [ ] Document follows markdown formatting standards
- [ ] Technical diagrams are clear and well-labeled
- [ ] Images and diagrams are high quality
- [ ] Links and references are working and accurate
- [ ] File naming follows established conventions
page_texts.7:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#governance-alignment]

### Governance Alignment

- [ ] Standard aligns with enterprise architecture principles
- [ ] Related standards and dependencies are identified
- [ ] Compliance assessment approach is defined
- [ ] Monitoring and enforcement mechanisms are specified
- [ ] Exception handling process is comprehensive
- [ ] Governance oversight roles are clearly defined
page_texts.9:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#business-alignment]

### Business Alignment

- [ ] Standard addresses a real business need
- [ ] Business rationale is compelling and well-supported
- [ ] Implementation benefits justify compliance costs
- [ ] Standard supports organizational strategy and objectives
- [ ] Stakeholder concerns have been addressed
page_texts.10:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#technical-review]

### Technical Review

- [ ] Technical requirements are sound and feasible
- [ ] Implementation approach is practical and scalable
- [ ] Technology choices are appropriate and current
- [ ] Performance and scalability considerations are covered
- [ ] Security implications have been assessed
page_texts.11:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#usability-review]

### Usability Review

- [ ] Target audience can understand and implement the standard
- [ ] Implementation guidelines are clear and actionable
- [ ] Examples are relevant and helpful
- [ ] Documentation requirements are reasonable
- [ ] Validation criteria are practical
page_texts.12:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#compliance-review]

### Compliance Review

- [ ] Compliance requirements are measurable and verifiable
- [ ] Assessment criteria are objective and fair
- [ ] Monitoring approach is feasible and cost-effective
- [ ] Exception process is balanced and practical
- [ ] Enforcement mechanisms are appropriate
page_texts.13:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#completeness-review]

### Completeness Review

- [ ] All template sections are completed appropriately
- [ ] Related standards and dependencies are identified
- [ ] External references are relevant and current
- [ ] Change history section is present and properly formatted
- [ ] Initial change history entry documents standard creation
- [ ] Review log section is present and properly formatted
- [ ] All completed reviews are documented in review log
page_texts.15:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#strategic-alignment]

### Strategic Alignment

- [ ] Standard supports organizational architecture strategy
- [ ] Standard is consistent with technology roadmap
- [ ] Business value and benefits are clear
- [ ] Standard promotes architectural consistency
- [ ] Investment in compliance is justified
page_texts.16:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#governance-compliance]

### Governance Compliance

- [ ] Standard follows established governance processes
- [ ] Appropriate stakeholder consultation has occurred
- [ ] Regulatory and compliance requirements are addressed
- [ ] Risk assessment and mitigation are documented
- [ ] Impact on existing systems is understood
page_texts.17:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#organizational-impact]

### Organizational Impact

- [ ] Implementation strategy is realistic and achievable
- [ ] Training and support needs are identified
- [ ] Change management implications are addressed
- [ ] Resource requirements are reasonable
- [ ] Timeline for compliance is appropriate
page_texts.18:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#enforcement-strategy]

### Enforcement Strategy

- [ ] Compliance monitoring approach is defined
- [ ] Enforcement mechanisms are appropriate
- [ ] Exception handling process is fair and transparent
- [ ] Appeals process is documented
- [ ] Continuous improvement mechanism is established
page_texts.20:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#final-quality-assurance]

### Final Quality Assurance

- [ ] All reviewer feedback has been addressed
- [ ] Standard status is updated to "approved"
- [ ] Document is properly formatted and polished
- [ ] Standard is added to catalog and compliance framework
- [ ] Communication plan is executed
page_texts.21:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#implementation-support]

### Implementation Support

- [ ] Implementation guidance is comprehensive
- [ ] Training materials are available
- [ ] Support resources are identified
- [ ] Compliance assessment tools are prepared
- [ ] Monitoring and reporting systems are in place
page_texts.22:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#accessibility-and-discovery]

### Accessibility and Discovery

- [ ] Standard is properly tagged and categorized
- [ ] Search keywords are appropriate
- [ ] Standard is linked from related standards
- [ ] Cross-references are accurate and complete
- [ ] Index and catalog entries are updated
page_texts.24:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#relevance-review]

### Relevance Review

- [ ] Standard is still relevant and necessary
- [ ] Technology dependencies are current
- [ ] Implementation examples are up-to-date
- [ ] Compliance rates are acceptable
- [ ] Business objectives are still valid
page_texts.25:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#effectiveness-assessment]

### Effectiveness Assessment

- [ ] Standard is achieving intended outcomes
- [ ] Compliance costs are reasonable
- [ ] Implementation barriers have been addressed
- [ ] Stakeholder feedback is positive
- [ ] No significant issues or problems reported
page_texts.26:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#update-requirements]

### Update Requirements

- [ ] Content accuracy is verified
- [ ] New examples or use cases are added
- [ ] Technology references are updated
- [ ] Change history is updated with all modifications
- [ ] Review log is updated with current assessment
- [ ] Related standards are still relevant

---
page_texts.28:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#standards-author]

### Standards Author

- Complete pre-submission checklist
- Engage stakeholders throughout development process
- Address all reviewer feedback
- Maintain standard over time
- Monitor compliance and effectiveness
page_texts.29:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#stakeholder-reviewers]

### Stakeholder Reviewers

- Provide business and technical perspective
- Assess implementation feasibility
- Identify potential issues and risks
- Verify alignment with business needs
- Support standard adoption
page_texts.30:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#governance-body]

### Governance Body

- Evaluate strategic alignment
- Ensure governance compliance
- Consider organizational impact
- Approve standards for organizational enforcement
- Provide policy direction and oversight
page_texts.31:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#compliance-manager]

### Compliance Manager

- Develop compliance assessment approach
- Monitor organizational compliance
- Manage exception requests
- Report on compliance metrics
- Facilitate continuous improvement
page_texts.32:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#quality-metrics]

## Quality Metrics

Track these metrics to ensure standards quality:

- **Compliance Rate**: Percentage of applicable systems meeting the standard
- **Exception Rate**: Number and percentage of approved exceptions
- **Implementation Time**: Average time to achieve compliance
- **Stakeholder Satisfaction**: Feedback scores from standard users
- **Defect Rate**: Number of issues found in published standards
- **Update Frequency**: How often standards require updates
- **Cost Effectiveness**: ROI of standard implementation
page_texts.34:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#feedback-collection]

### Feedback Collection

- Regular surveys of standard implementers
- Post-implementation reviews and lessons learned
- Compliance assessment findings and trends
- Stakeholder feedback sessions
- Industry best practice research
page_texts.35:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#process-enhancement]

### Process Enhancement

- Regular review of quality checklist
- Updates based on lessons learned
- Streamlining of review and approval processes
- Tool and template improvements
- Training and support enhancements
page_texts.36:
[standards/standards-quality-checklist.md#standards-portfolio-management]

### Standards Portfolio Management

- Regular portfolio review and rationalization
- Identification of gaps and overlaps
- Strategic planning for new standards
- Retirement of obsolete standards
- Harmonization across related standards
